Her Story

She Has a Miracle. She Is a Miracle.

Miracle Survivor is a mother's story of faith, strength, hope, and a little girl who defied the odds.

It tells a journey through unimaginable circumstances, recovery, love, perseverance, and the moments that make every step forward meaningful.

More Than a Book

It is a testimony and a mother's promise to tell her daughter's story. It is also a reminder that one difficult chapter does not have to be the end.

“She has a miracle. She is a miracle. She is our miracle.”

About the Author

Destiny Robinson

Destiny Robinson is Miracle's mom and the author of Miracle Survivor. She shares their story to honor Miracle's journey and to give hope to families facing their own difficult seasons.
